"""Two users, same item, same moment.

Talks to a real Taiga API (gunicorn, 3 worker processes, Postgres) over HTTP.
Each trial builds fresh items, then releases two requests (one per user) at
the same instant through a barrier, and inspects what was stored.
"""
import collections
import datetime
import sys
import threading
import time

import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8777/api/v1/"
N = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20
ONLY = sys.argv[2:] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None


class User:
    def __init__(self, username):
        self.s = requests.Session()
        r = self.s.post(BASE + "auth", json={"type": "normal", "username": username, "password": "audit-pass-123"})
        r.raise_for_status()
        self.id = r.json()["id"]
        self.s.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + r.json()["auth_token"]
        self.s.headers["x-disable-pagination"] = "1"

    def call(self, method, path, json=None, ok=True):
        r = self.s.request(method, BASE + path, json=json)
        if ok and r.status_code >= 400:
            raise RuntimeError("%s %s -> %s %s" % (method, path, r.status_code, r.text[:300]))
        return r

    def get(self, path):
        return self.call("get", path).json()

    def post(self, path, json, ok=True):
        return self.call("post", path, json, ok)

    def patch(self, path, json, ok=False):
        return self.call("patch", path, json, ok)

    def delete(self, path, ok=False):
        return self.call("delete", path, None, ok)


def race(*calls):
    """Run the given zero-arg callables at the same instant; return their results in order."""
    barrier = threading.Barrier(len(calls))
    out = [None] * len(calls)

    def run(i, fn):
        barrier.wait()
        try:
            out[i] = fn()
        except Exception as e:  # noqa
            out[i] = e

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=run, args=(i, fn)) for i, fn in enumerate(calls)]
    [t.start() for t in threads]
    [t.join() for t in threads]
    return out


class Board:
    """A fresh scrum project shared by alice (owner) and bob (admin member)."""
    counter = 0

    def __init__(self, alice, bob):
        Board.counter += 1
        self.a, self.b = alice, bob
        stamp = "%s-%d" % (int(time.time() * 1000), Board.counter)
        p = alice.post("projects", {"name": "Race " + stamp, "description": "x",
                                    "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
        self.pid = p["id"]
        self.stamp = stamp
        roles = alice.get("roles?project=%s" % self.pid)
        role = [r for r in roles if r["name"] == "Back"][0]["id"]
        alice.post("memberships", {"project": self.pid, "role": role, "username": "bob", "is_admin": True})
        self.us_status = {s["name"]: s["id"] for s in alice.get("userstory-statuses?project=%s" % self.pid)}
        self.task_status = {s["name"]: s["id"] for s in alice.get("task-statuses?project=%s" % self.pid)}
        self._n = 0

    def sprint(self, name, offset=0):
        start = datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=offset)
        return self.a.post("milestones", {"project": self.pid, "name": "%s %s" % (name, self.stamp),
                                          "estimated_start": str(start),
                                          "estimated_finish": str(start + datetime.timedelta(days=14))}).json()

    def story(self, subject="Story", **extra):
        return self.a.post("userstories", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def task(self, subject="Task", **extra):
        return self.a.post("tasks", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def issue(self, subject="Issue", **extra):
        return self.a.post("issues", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def epic(self, subject="Epic", **extra):
        return self.a.post("epics", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()


def codes(results):
    return tuple(r.status_code if hasattr(r, "status_code") else "EXC:%s" % r for r in results)


def report(title, expected, tally, notes=None):
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print(title)
    print("  expected: " + expected)
    total = sum(tally.values())
    for outcome, n in tally.most_common():
        print("  %3d/%d  %s" % (n, total, outcome))
    for n in notes or []:
        print("  note: " + n)
    sys.stdout.flush()


SCENARIOS = collections.OrderedDict()


def scenario(fn):
    SCENARIOS[fn.__name__] = fn
    return fn


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Control: the same edits a moment apart (not simultaneous)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c00_control_one_after_the_other(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    b = Board(alice, bob)
    us = b.story("orig")
    v = us["version"]
    r1 = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"subject": "alice title", "version": v})
    r2 = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"description": "bob text", "version": v})
    final = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])
    tally["different fields, bob saves with the version he loaded earlier: http %s -> subject=%r description=%r" % (
        codes([r1, r2]), final["subject"], final["description"])] += 1
    r3 = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"subject": "bob title", "version": v})
    final = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])
    tally["same field, bob saves with the old version: http %s -> subject=%r" % (
        r3.status_code, final["subject"])] += 1
    report("C0  CONTROL: two users edit the same story one after the other",
           "second save of a different field is merged; second save of the same field is refused", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Simultaneous edits of different fields of one item
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _different_fields(alice, bob, kind, make, title):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        obj = make(b)
        path = "%s/%s" % (kind, obj["id"])
        v = obj["version"]
        res = race(lambda: alice.patch(path, {"subject": "alice title", "version": v}),
                   lambda: bob.patch(path, {"description": "bob text", "version": v}))
        final = alice.get(path)
        kept_a = final["subject"] == "alice title"
        kept_b = final["description"] == "bob text"
        if kept_a and kept_b:
            outcome = "both changes kept"
        elif kept_b:
            outcome = "ALICE'S TITLE LOST (reverted to old value)"
        elif kept_a:
            outcome = "BOB'S TEXT LOST (reverted to old value)"
        else:
            outcome = "both lost"
        tally["http %s -> %s" % (codes(res), outcome)] += 1
    report(title, "both get 200 and both changes are kept", tally)


@scenario
def c01_story_different_fields(alice, bob):
    _different_fields(alice, bob, "userstories", lambda b: b.story("orig"),
                      "C1  Same user story: alice changes the title, bob changes the description, same instant")

def c02_task_different_fields(alice, bob):

def c03_issue_different_fields(alice, bob):

@scenario
def c05_sprint_different_fields(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        m = b.sprint("Sprint")
        path = "milestones/%s" % m["id"]

        final = alice.get(path)
        ok_a, ok_b = final["name"].startswith("renamed"), final["disponibility"] == 7.5
        tally["http %s -> %s" % (codes(res), "both changes kept" if ok_a and ok_b else
                                 "ALICE'S RENAME LOST" if ok_b else "BOB'S CHANGE LOST" if ok_a else "both lost")] += 1
    report("C5  Same sprint: alice renames it, bob changes its capacity field, same instant",
           "both get 200 and both changes are kept", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Simultaneous edits of the same field
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c06_story_same_field(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        us = b.story("orig")

        res = race(lambda: alice.patch(path, {"subject": "alice title", "version": v}),

        tally["http %s -> stored title is %s's, version %d->%d" % (
            tuple(sorted(codes(res))), final["subject"].split()[0], v, final["version"])] += 1

           "one 200 and one 400 'version doesn't match'; never two 200s", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. One edits a field while the other comments / both comment
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario

    tally = collections.Counter()

        us = b.story("orig")

                   lambda: bob.patch(path, {"comment": "bob comment", "version": v}))
        final = alice.get(path)
        comments = [h["comment"] for h in alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % us["id"]) if h["comment"]]
        moved = final["status"] == b.us_status["In progress"]
        tally["http %s -> %s, comment %s" % (codes(res),
                                             "status change kept" if moved else "ALICE'S STATUS CHANGE LOST (back to New)",
                                             "kept" if "bob comment" in comments else "LOST")] += 1
    report("C7  Same user story: alice moves it to In progress while bob posts a comment",
           "status is In progress and the comment is there", tally)


@scenario

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

"""Two users, same item, same moment.

Talks to a real Taiga API (gunicorn, 3 worker processes, Postgres) over HTTP.
Each trial builds fresh items, then releases two requests (one per user) at
the same instant through a barrier, and inspects what was stored.
"""
import collections
import datetime
import sys
import threading
import time

import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8777/api/v1/"
N = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 20
ONLY = sys.argv[2:] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None


class User:
    def __init__(self, username):
        self.s = requests.Session()
        r = self.s.post(BASE + "auth", json={"type": "normal", "username": username, "password": "audit-pass-123"})
        r.raise_for_status()
        self.id = r.json()["id"]
        self.s.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + r.json()["auth_token"]
        self.s.headers["x-disable-pagination"] = "1"

    def call(self, method, path, json=None, ok=True):
        r = self.s.request(method, BASE + path, json=json)
        if ok and r.status_code >= 400:
            raise RuntimeError("%s %s -> %s %s" % (method, path, r.status_code, r.text[:300]))
        return r

    def get(self, path):
        return self.call("get", path).json()

    def post(self, path, json, ok=True):
        return self.call("post", path, json, ok)

    def patch(self, path, json, ok=False):
        return self.call("patch", path, json, ok)

    def delete(self, path, ok=False):
        return self.call("delete", path, None, ok)


def race(*calls):
    """Run the given zero-arg callables at the same instant; return their results in order."""
    barrier = threading.Barrier(len(calls))
    out = [None] * len(calls)

    def run(i, fn):
        barrier.wait()
        try:
            out[i] = fn()
        except Exception as e:  # noqa
            out[i] = e

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=run, args=(i, fn)) for i, fn in enumerate(calls)]
    [t.start() for t in threads]
    [t.join() for t in threads]
    return out


class Board:
    """A fresh scrum project shared by alice (owner) and bob (admin member)."""
    counter = 0

    def __init__(self, alice, bob):
        Board.counter += 1
        self.a, self.b = alice, bob
        stamp = "%s-%d" % (int(time.time() * 1000), Board.counter)
        p = alice.post("projects", {"name": "Race " + stamp, "description": "x",
                                    "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
        self.pid = p["id"]
        self.stamp = stamp
        roles = alice.get("roles?project=%s" % self.pid)
        role = [r for r in roles if r["name"] == "Back"][0]["id"]
        alice.post("memberships", {"project": self.pid, "role": role, "username": "bob", "is_admin": True})
        self.us_status = {s["name"]: s["id"] for s in alice.get("userstory-statuses?project=%s" % self.pid)}
        self.task_status = {s["name"]: s["id"] for s in alice.get("task-statuses?project=%s" % self.pid)}
        self._n = 0

    def sprint(self, name, offset=0):
        start = datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=offset)
        return self.a.post("milestones", {"project": self.pid, "name": "%s %s" % (name, self.stamp),
                                          "estimated_start": str(start),
                                          "estimated_finish": str(start + datetime.timedelta(days=14))}).json()

    def story(self, subject="Story", **extra):
        return self.a.post("userstories", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def task(self, subject="Task", **extra):
        return self.a.post("tasks", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def issue(self, subject="Issue", **extra):
        return self.a.post("issues", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def epic(self, subject="Epic", **extra):
        return self.a.post("epics", dict(project=self.pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()


def codes(results):
    return tuple(r.status_code if hasattr(r, "status_code") else "EXC:%s" % r for r in results)


def report(title, expected, tally, notes=None):
    print("\n" + "=" * 96)
    print(title)
    print("  expected: " + expected)
    total = sum(tally.values())
    for outcome, n in tally.most_common():
        print("  %3d/%d  %s" % (n, total, outcome))
    for n in notes or []:
        print("  note: " + n)
    sys.stdout.flush()


SCENARIOS = collections.OrderedDict()


def scenario(fn):
    SCENARIOS[fn.__name__] = fn
    return fn


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Control: the same edits a moment apart (not simultaneous)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c00_control_one_after_the_other(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    b = Board(alice, bob)
    us = b.story("orig")
    v = us["version"]
    r1 = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"subject": "alice title", "version": v})
    r2 = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"description": "bob text", "version": v})
    final = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])
    tally["different fields, bob saves with the version he loaded earlier: http %s -> subject=%r description=%r" % (
        codes([r1, r2]), final["subject"], final["description"])] += 1
    r3 = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"subject": "bob title", "version": v})
    final = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])
    tally["same field, bob saves with the old version: http %s -> subject=%r" % (
        r3.status_code, final["subject"])] += 1
    report("C0  CONTROL: two users edit the same story one after the other",
           "second save of a different field is merged; second save of the same field is refused", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Simultaneous edits of different fields of one item
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _different_fields(alice, bob, kind, make, title):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):

        res = race(lambda: alice.patch(path, {"subject": "alice title", "version": v}),
                   lambda: bob.patch(path, {"description": "bob text", "version": v}))
        final = alice.get(path)
        kept_a = final["subject"] == "alice title"
        kept_b = final["description"] == "bob text"
        if kept_a and kept_b:
            outcome = "both changes kept"
        elif kept_b:
            outcome = "ALICE'S TITLE LOST (reverted to old value)"
        elif kept_a:
            outcome = "BOB'S TEXT LOST (reverted to old value)"
        else:
            outcome = "both lost"
        tally["http %s -> %s" % (codes(res), outcome)] += 1
    report(title, "both get 200 and both changes are kept", tally)


@scenario
def c01_story_different_fields(alice, bob):
    _different_fields(alice, bob, "userstories", lambda b: b.story("orig"),
                      "C1  Same user story: alice changes the title, bob changes the description, same instant")

@scenario
def c05_sprint_different_fields(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        m = b.sprint("Sprint")
        path = "milestones/%s" % m["id"]

                                 "ALICE'S RENAME LOST" if ok_b else "BOB'S CHANGE LOST" if ok_a else "both lost")] += 1
    report("C5  Same sprint: alice renames it, bob changes its capacity field, same instant",
           "both get 200 and both changes are kept", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Simultaneous edits of the same field
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c06_story_same_field(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):

           "one 200 and one 400 'version doesn't match'; never two 200s", tally)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. One edits a field while the other comments / both comment
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c07_status_change_vs_comment(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        us = b.story("orig")
        path = "userstories/%s" % us["id"]
        v = us["version"]
        res = race(lambda: alice.patch(path, {"status": b.us_status["In progress"], "version": v}),
                   lambda: bob.patch(path, {"comment": "bob comment", "version": v}))
        final = alice.get(path)
        comments = [h["comment"] for h in alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % us["id"]) if h["comment"]]
        moved = final["status"] == b.us_status["In progress"]
        tally["http %s -> %s, comment %s" % (codes(res),
                                             "status change kept" if moved else "ALICE'S STATUS CHANGE LOST (back to New)",
                                             "kept" if "bob comment" in comments else "LOST")] += 1
    report("C7  Same user story: alice moves it to In progress while bob posts a comment",
           "status is In progress and the comment is there", tally)


@scenario
def c08_both_comment(alice, bob):

    for _ in range(N):

        tally["http %s -> comments stored: %s" % (codes(res), comments)] += 1

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Closing the last pieces of work at the same time

@scenario

        fus = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])

# 6. Board moves at the same time
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
@scenario
def c15_same_story_two_columns_bulk(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        us = b.story("story")
        res = race(lambda: alice.post("userstories/bulk_update_kanban_order", {
                       "project_id": b.pid, "status_id": b.us_status["Done"], "bulk_userstories": [us["id"]]}, ok=False),
                   lambda: bob.post("userstories/bulk_update_kanban_order", {
                       "project_id": b.pid, "status_id": b.us_status["In progress"], "bulk_userstories": [us["id"]]}, ok=False))
        time.sleep(0.05)
        f = alice.get("userstories/%s" % us["id"])
        name = [k for k, v in b.us_status.items() if v == f["status"]][0]
        consistent = f["is_closed"] == (name == "Done")
        tally["http %s -> %s" % (codes(res), "status and closed flag agree" if consistent else
                                 "STATUS %r BUT is_closed=%s" % (name, f["is_closed"]))] += 1
    report("C15 alice drags a story to Done while bob drags the same story to In progress (board drag call)",
           "one wins; the closed flag matches the final column", tally)


@scenario
def c16_same_story_two_columns_single(alice, bob):
    tally = collections.Counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = Board(alice, bob)
        us = b.story("story")
        path = "userstories/%s" % us["id"]
        res = race(lambda: alice.patch(path, {"status": b.us_status["Done"], "version": us["version"]}),
                   lambda: bob.patch(path, {"status": b.us_status["In progress"], "version": us["version"]}))

def c17_delete_vs_edit(alice, bob):

"""How close together do two saves have to be? Bob starts d ms after Alice."""
import sys, time, threading, statistics
sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], "1", "none"]
import race as R

alice, bob = R.User("alice"), R.User("bob")
b = R.Board(alice, bob)

# duration of one ordinary save on this machine
durs = []
for i in range(8):
    us = b.story("timing")
    t = time.time()
    alice.patch("userstories/%s" % us["id"], {"subject": "x%d" % i, "version": us["version"]})
    durs.append((time.time() - t) * 1000)
print("one story save takes: median %.0f ms (min %.0f, max %.0f)" % (statistics.median(durs), min(durs), max(durs)))

for delay_ms in (0, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400):
    lost = errors = 0
    trials = 10
    for _ in range(trials):
        us = b.story("orig")
        path, v = "userstories/%s" % us["id"], us["version"]
        out = {}
        ta = threading.Thread(target=lambda: out.__setitem__("a", alice.patch(path, {"subject": "alice title", "version": v})))
        tb = threading.Thread(target=lambda: out.__setitem__("b", bob.patch(path, {"description": "bob text", "version": v})))
        ta.start(); time.sleep(delay_ms / 1000.0); tb.start(); ta.join(); tb.join()
        f = alice.get(path)
        if out["a"].status_code != 200 or out["b"].status_code != 200:
            errors += 1
        if not (f["subject"] == "alice title" and f["description"] == "bob text"):
            lost += 1
    print("bob saves %3d ms after alice: a change was lost in %d/%d trials (non-200 responses: %d)" % (delay_ms, lost, trials, errors))
EOF

content.text:
When two users save the same item within about a third of a second of each other, one user's change is silently thrown away even though both are told the save succeeded. Simultaneous planning and board moves have related problems.

I ran the API under gunicorn with 3 workers (the same setup as `docker/entrypoint.sh`) against Postgres, with two logged-in users on one board. Each scenario released both users' requests at the same instant, 20 trials on fresh items.

## Results

| Two users at the same instant | Result (20 trials) |
|---|---|
| Edit different fields of one **story** (title vs description) | **One change lost in 20/20**, both got 200 |
| Same on a **task**, **issue**, **epic**, **sprint** | **One change lost in 20/20** for each, both got 200 |
| One moves a story to In progress, the other posts a comment | **Status change lost in 11/20**; comment always kept |
| Both drag a different story to the top of the backlog | **One drag lost in 12/20**, both got 200 |
| One drags a story into a sprint, the other edits that story | **One of them got a 500 in 15/20** |
| Both drag the same story to different board columns (board drag call) | **5/20 ended In progress but still flagged closed** |
| One moves a story to the next sprint, the other adds a task to it | **Task left in the old sprint in 2/20**; one 500 |
| One deletes a story, the other saves an edit | Story deleted correctly, but **the editor got a 500 in 19/20** |
| Both edit the same field of one story | Correct: one 200, one 400 "version doesn't match", 20/20 |
| Both comment on one story | Correct: both comments stored, 20/20 |
| Each closes one of the last two tasks of a story | Correct: story and sprint closed, 20/20 |
| Each closes one of the last two stories of a sprint | Correct: sprint closed, 20/20 |
| Both drag the same story into different sprints | Correct: story and its task stay together, 20/20 |
| Both create a story and a task | Correct: four distinct reference numbers, 20/20 |

## What matters most

- **The silent lost edit is the serious one.** The loser's field goes back to its old value and nothing tells them.
- **The window is about one save long.** A story save took about 300 ms on this machine. With the second save starting 0–100 ms after the first, a change was lost 10/10 times; at 200 ms, 5/10; at 400 ms, 0/10. Email sending was disabled in this setup, so I can't say how long a save takes on your server.
- **A stale browser copy is handled correctly.** When the second user saved a moment later using the version they had loaded earlier, a different field was merged and the same field was refused.
- **Cause of the lost edit:** the item is read before the per-item lock is taken, then written back in full. That read happens in `taiga/projects/notifications/mixins.py:93` and in each `update()` override, for example `taiga/projects/userstories/api.py:311`.
- **The lost backlog drag** comes from `bulk_update_backlog_order` renumbering every story after the insertion point with no lock, so one call overwrites the other's move.
- **The 500s are two different errors.** Drag-versus-edit is a database deadlock in the history snapshot; delete-versus-edit is an unhandled "does not exist" in the version check (`taiga/projects/occ/mixins.py:44`). In the 20 drag-versus-edit trials, whoever got the 500 was also the one whose change was missing, so that loss was not silent.

The repo is untouched; the test server and database container are stopped and removed.

Files are in `/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad`:
- `probe/race.py`
- `probe/race_window.py`
- `race1.txt`
- `server_errors.txt`

from django.utils.translation import gettext as _
from taiga.base.api import serializers
from taiga.base.api import validators
from taiga.base.exceptions import ValidationError
from . import services
from . import fields
import re
class ProjectTagValidator(validators.Validator):
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # Don't pass the extra project arg
        self.project = kwargs.pop("project")
        # Instantiate the superclass normally
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
class CreateTagValidator(ProjectTagValidator):
    tag = serializers.CharField()
    color = serializers.CharField(required=False)
    def validate_tag(self, attrs, source):
        tag = attrs.get(source, None)
        if services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
            raise ValidationError(_("This tag already exists."))
        return attrs
    def validate_color(self, attrs, source):
        color = attrs.get(source, None)
        if color and not re.match(r'^\#([a-fA-F0-9]{6}|[a-fA-F0-9]{3})$', color):
            raise ValidationError(_("The color is not a valid HEX color."))
        return attrs
class EditTagTagValidator(ProjectTagValidator):
    from_tag = serializers.CharField()
    to_tag = serializers.CharField(required=False)
    color = serializers.CharField(required=False)
    def validate_from_tag(self, attrs, source):
        tag = attrs.get(source, None)
        if not services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
            raise ValidationError(_("The tag doesn't exist."))
        return attrs
    def validate_to_tag(self, attrs, source):
        tag = attrs.get(source, None)
        from_tag = attrs.get("from_tag", None)
        if tag != from_tag and services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
            raise ValidationError(_("This tag already exists."))
        return attrs
    def validate_color(self, attrs, source):
        color = attrs.get(source, None)
        if color and not re.match(r'^\#([a-fA-F0-9]{6}|[a-fA-F0-9]{3})$', color):
            raise ValidationError(_("The color is not a valid HEX color."))
        return attrs
    def validate(self, data):
        if "to_tag" not in data:
            data["to_tag"] = data.get("from_tag")
        if "color" not in data:
            data["color"] = dict(self.project.tags_colors).get(data.get("from_tag"))
        return data
class DeleteTagValidator(ProjectTagValidator):
    tag = serializers.CharField()
    def validate_tag(self, attrs, source):
        tag = attrs.get(source, None)
        if not services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
            raise ValidationError(_("The tag doesn't exist."))
        return attrs
class MixTagsValidator(ProjectTagValidator):
    from_tags = fields.TagsField()
    to_tag = serializers.CharField()
    def validate_from_tags(self, attrs, source):
        tags = attrs.get(source, None)
        for tag in tags:
            if not services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
                raise ValidationError(_("The tag doesn't exist."))
        return attrs
    def validate_to_tag(self, attrs, source):
        tag = attrs.get(source, None)
        if not services.tag_exist_for_project_elements(self.project, tag):
            raise ValidationError(_("The tag doesn't exist."))
        return attrs

from django.forms import widgets
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from taiga.base.api import serializers
from taiga.base.exceptions import ValidationError
import re
class TagsAndTagsColorsField(serializers.WritableField):
    """
    Pickle objects serializer fior stories, tasks and issues tags.
    """
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        def _validate_tag_field(value):
            # Valid field:
            #    - ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"...]
            #    - ["tag1", ["tag2", None], ["tag3", "#ccc"], [tag4, #cccccc]...]
            for tag in value:
                if isinstance(tag, str):
                    continue
                if isinstance(tag, (list, tuple)) and len(tag) == 2:
                    name = tag[0]
                    color = tag[1]
                    if isinstance(name, str):
                        if color is None or color == "":
                            continue
                        if isinstance(color, str) and re.match(r'^\#([a-fA-F0-9]{6}|[a-fA-F0-9]{3})$', color):
                            continue
                        raise ValidationError(_("Invalid tag '{value}'. The color is not a "
                                                "valid HEX color or null.").format(value=tag))
                raise ValidationError(_("Invalid tag '{value}'. it must be the name or a pair "
                                        "'[\"name\", \"hex color/\" | null]'.").format(value=tag))
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.validators.append(_validate_tag_field)
    def to_native(self, obj):
        return obj
    def from_native(self, data):
        return data
class TagsField(serializers.WritableField):
    """
    Pickle objects serializer for tags names.
    """
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        def _validate_tag_field(value):
            for tag in value:
                if isinstance(tag, str):
                    continue
                raise ValidationError(_("Invalid tag '{value}'. It must be the tag name.").format(value=tag))
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.validators.append(_validate_tag_field)
    def to_native(self, obj):
        return obj
    def from_native(self, data):
        return data
class TagsColorsField(serializers.WritableField):
    """
    PgArray objects serializer.
    """
    widget = widgets.Textarea
    def to_native(self, obj):
        return dict(obj)
    def from_native(self, data):
        return list(data.items())

REFRESH_PARAM = "_taiga-refresh"
def get_attachment_by_id(project_id, attachment_id):

    try:
        obj = model_cls.objects.select_related("content_type").get(id=attachment_id)

def generate_refresh_fragment(attachment, type_=""):
    if not attachment:

    type_ = attachment.content_type.model if not type_ else type_
    return "{}={}:{}".format(REFRESH_PARAM, type_, attachment.id)
def extract_refresh_id(url):
    if not url:
        return False, False
    _, frag = urldefrag(url)
    if not frag:
        return False, False
    qs = parse_qs(frag)
    if not qs:
        return False, False
    ref = qs.get(REFRESH_PARAM, False)
    if not ref:
        return False, False
    type_, _, id_ = ref[0].partition(":")
    try:
        return type_, int(id_)
    except ValueError:
        return False, False

    return None
def get_attachment_image_preview_url(attachment):

        return get_thumbnail_url(attachment.attached_file, settings.THN_ATTACHMENT_PREVIEW)
    return None
def update_order_in_bulk(item: Union["Epic", "UserStory", "Task", "Issue", "WikiPage"],
                         bulk_attachments: List[int],
                         after_attachment: Optional[models.Attachment] = None):
    """
    Updates the order of the attachments specified adding the extra updates
    needed to keep consistency.
     - `bulk_attachments` should be a list of attachment IDs
    """
    # get item attachments
    attachments = item.attachments.all()
    # exclude moved attachments
    attachments = attachments.exclude(id__in=bulk_attachments)
    # if after_attachment, exclude it and get only elements after it:
    if after_attachment:
        attachments = (attachments.exclude(id=after_attachment.id)
                                  .filter(order__gte=after_attachment.order))
    # sort and get only ids
    attachment_ids = (attachments.order_by("order", "id")
                                  .values_list('id', flat=True))
    # append moved user stories
    attachment_ids = bulk_attachments + list(attachment_ids)
    # calculate the start order
    if after_attachment:
        # order start after the after_attachment order
        start_order = after_attachment.order + 1
    else:
        # move at the beggining of the column if there is no after and before
        start_order = 1
    # prepare rest of data
    total_attachments = len(attachment_ids)
    attachment_orders = range(start_order, start_order + total_attachments)
    data = tuple(zip(attachment_ids,
                     attachment_orders))
    # execute query for update order
    sql = """
    UPDATE attachments_attachment
       SET "order" = tmp.new_order::BIGINT
      FROM (VALUES %s) AS tmp (id, new_order)
     WHERE tmp.id = attachments_attachment.id
    """
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        execute_values(cursor, sql, data)
    # Generate response with modified info
    res = ({
        "id": id,
        "order": order
    } for (id, order) in data)
    return res

        self._orig_attached_file = self.attached_file
    def _generate_sha1(self, blocksize=65536):
        hasher = hashlib.sha1()
        while True:
            buff = self.attached_file.file.read(blocksize)
            if not buff:
                break
            hasher.update(buff)
        self.sha1 = hasher.hexdigest()
    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self._importing or not self.modified_date:
            self.modified_date = timezone.now()
        if self.attached_file:
            if not self.sha1 or self.attached_file != self._orig_attached_file:
                self._generate_sha1()
        save = super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        self._orig_attached_file = self.attached_file
        if self.attached_file:
            self.attached_file.file.close()
        return save
    def __str__(self):
        return "Attachment: {}".format(self.id)

class UpdateAttachmentsOrderBulkValidator(validators.Validator):
    content_type_id = serializers.IntegerField()
    object_id = serializers.IntegerField()
    after_attachment_id = serializers.IntegerField(required=False)
    bulk_attachments = ListField(child=serializers.IntegerField(min_value=1))
    def validate_after_attachment_id(self, attrs, source):
        if (attrs.get(source, None) is not None
                and attrs.get("content_type_id", None) is not None
                and attrs.get("object_id", None) is not None):
            filters = {
                "content_type__id": attrs["content_type_id"],
                "object_id": attrs["object_id"],
                "id": attrs[source]
            }
            if not models.Attachment.objects.filter(**filters).exists():
                raise ValidationError(_("Invalid attachment id to move after. The attachment must belong "
                                        "to the same item (epic, userstory, task, issue or wiki page)."))
        return attrs
    def validate_bulk_attachments(self, attrs, source):
        if (attrs.get("content_type_id", None) is not None
                and attrs.get("object_id", None) is not None):
            filters = {
                "content_type__id": attrs["content_type_id"],
                "object_id": attrs["object_id"],
                "id__in": attrs[source]
            }
            if models.Attachment.objects.filter(**filters).count() != len(filters["id__in"]):
                raise ValidationError(_("Invalid attachment ids. All attachments must belong to the same "
                                        "item (epic, userstory, task, issue or wiki page)."))
        return attrs

REFRESH_PARAM = "_taiga-refresh"
def get_attachment_by_id(project_id, attachment_id):
    model_cls = apps.get_model("attachments", "Attachment")
    try:
        obj = model_cls.objects.select_related("content_type").get(id=attachment_id)
    except model_cls.DoesNotExist:
        return None
    if not obj.content_object or obj.content_object.project_id != project_id:
        return None
    return obj
def generate_refresh_fragment(attachment, type_=""):
    if not attachment:
        return ''
    type_ = attachment.content_type.model if not type_ else type_
    return "{}={}:{}".format(REFRESH_PARAM, type_, attachment.id)
def extract_refresh_id(url):
    if not url:
        return False, False
    _, frag = urldefrag(url)
    if not frag:
        return False, False
    qs = parse_qs(frag)
    if not qs:
        return False, False
    ref = qs.get(REFRESH_PARAM, False)
    if not ref:
        return False, False
    type_, _, id_ = ref[0].partition(":")
    try:
        return type_, int(id_)
    except ValueError:
        return False, False

    if not url:

    return url if url.startswith(base or settings.MEDIA_URL) else None

def update_order_in_bulk(item: Union["Epic", "UserStory", "Task", "Issue", "WikiPage"],
                         bulk_attachments: List[int],
                         after_attachment: Optional[models.Attachment] = None):
    """
    Updates the order of the attachments specified adding the extra updates
    needed to keep consistency.
     - `bulk_attachments` should be a list of attachment IDs
    """
    # get item attachments
    attachments = item.attachments.all()
    # exclude moved attachments
    attachments = attachments.exclude(id__in=bulk_attachments)
    # if after_attachment, exclude it and get only elements after it:
    if after_attachment:
        attachments = (attachments.exclude(id=after_attachment.id)
                                  .filter(order__gte=after_attachment.order))
    # sort and get only ids
    attachment_ids = (attachments.order_by("order", "id")
                                  .values_list('id', flat=True))
    # append moved user stories
    attachment_ids = bulk_attachments + list(attachment_ids)
    # calculate the start order
    if after_attachment:
        # order start after the after_attachment order
        start_order = after_attachment.order + 1
    else:
        # move at the beggining of the column if there is no after and before
        start_order = 1
    # prepare rest of data
    total_attachments = len(attachment_ids)
    attachment_orders = range(start_order, start_order + total_attachments)
    data = tuple(zip(attachment_ids,
                     attachment_orders))
    # execute query for update order
    sql = """
    UPDATE attachments_attachment
       SET "order" = tmp.new_order::BIGINT
      FROM (VALUES %s) AS tmp (id, new_order)
     WHERE tmp.id = attachments_attachment.id
    """
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        execute_values(cursor, sql, data)
    # Generate response with modified info
    res = ({
        "id": id,
        "order": order
    } for (id, order) in data)
    return res

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super(Attachment, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._orig_attached_file = self.attached_file
    def _generate_sha1(self, blocksize=65536):
        hasher = hashlib.sha1()
        while True:
            buff = self.attached_file.file.read(blocksize)
            if not buff:
                break
            hasher.update(buff)
        self.sha1 = hasher.hexdigest()
    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self._importing or not self.modified_date:
            self.modified_date = timezone.now()
        if self.attached_file:
            if not self.sha1 or self.attached_file != self._orig_attached_file:
                self._generate_sha1()
        save = super().save(*args, **kwargs)
        self._orig_attached_file = self.attached_file
        if self.attached_file:
            self.attached_file.file.close()
        return save
    def __str__(self):
        return "Attachment: {}".format(self.id)

import hashlib
from os import path, urandom
from unidecode import unidecode
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.encoding import force_bytes
from taiga.base.utils.iterators import split_by_n
def get_file_path(instance, filename, base_path):
    basename = path.basename(filename).lower()
    base, ext = path.splitext(basename)
    base = slugify(unidecode(base))[0:100]
    basename = "".join([base, ext])
    hs = hashlib.sha256()
    hs.update(force_bytes(timezone.now().isoformat()))
    hs.update(urandom(1024))
    p1, p2, p3, p4, *p5 = split_by_n(hs.hexdigest(), 1)
    hash_part = path.join(p1, p2, p3, p4, "".join(p5))
    return path.join(base_path, hash_part, basename)

import hashlib
from os import path, urandom
from unidecode import unidecode
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.encoding import force_bytes
from taiga.base.utils.iterators import split_by_n
def get_file_path(instance, filename, base_path):
    basename = path.basename(filename).lower()
    base, ext = path.splitext(basename)
    base = slugify(unidecode(base))[0:100]
    basename = "".join([base, ext])
    hs = hashlib.sha256()
    hs.update(force_bytes(timezone.now().isoformat()))
    hs.update(urandom(1024))
    p1, p2, p3, p4, *p5 = split_by_n(hs.hexdigest(), 1)
    hash_part = path.join(p1, p2, p3, p4, "".join(p5))
    return path.join(base_path, hash_part, basename)

"""Tags and attachments, driven over the real HTTP API (gunicorn + Postgres).

Users:  alice   = owner/admin of project P1
        bob     = member of P1, full editor role, not admin
        carol   = member of P1, can view and comment only
        vic     = member of P1, view only
        nora    = member of P1, can see the project but not user stories
        mallory = not a member of P1; owns her own project P2
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], "1", "none"]
import race as R  # noqa: E402  (User class, BASE)

MEDIA = "/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad/media"
VIEW = ["view_project", "view_milestones", "view_epics", "view_us", "view_tasks", "view_issues"]


def sql(stmt):
    subprocess.run(["docker", "exec", "taiga-audit-pg", "psql", "-U", "taiga", "-d", "taiga", "-q", "-c", stmt],
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def line(label, expect, got, ok=None):
    if ok is None:
        ok = str(expect) == str(got)
    print("  [%s] %-62s expect: %-22s got: %s" % ("ok " if ok else "DIFF", label, expect, got))
    sys.stdout.flush()


def head(title):
    print("\n" + "=" * 110 + "\n" + title)


def upload(user, kind, pid, oid, name="spec.txt", body=b"hello attachment", **extra):
    data = dict(project=pid, object_id=oid, **extra)
    return user.s.post(R.BASE + "%s/attachments" % kind, data=data, files={"attached_file": (name, body)})


def new_project(owner, name):
    p = owner.post("projects", {"name": "%s %d" % (name, int(time.time() * 1000)), "description": "x",
                                "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
    return p["id"]


def add_member(owner, pid, email, role_id, admin=False):
    return owner.post("memberships", {"project": pid, "role": role_id, "username": email, "is_admin": admin}).json()


def make_role(owner, pid, name, perms):
    return owner.post("roles", {"project": pid, "name": name, "permissions": perms, "computable": False,
                                "order": 99}).json()["id"]


def colors(user, pid):
    return user.get("projects/%s/tags_colors" % pid)


def main():
    alice, bob, carol, vic, nora, mallory = [R.User(n) for n in ("alice", "bob", "carol", "vic", "nora", "mallory")]
    p1 = new_project(alice, "P1")
    p2 = new_project(mallory, "P2")
    roles = {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in alice.get("roles?project=%s" % p1)}
    bob_m = add_member(alice, p1, "bob@example.test", roles["Back"])
    add_member(alice, p1, "carol@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Commenter", VIEW + ["comment_us", "comment_task", "comment_issue"]))
    add_member(alice, p1, "vic@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Viewer", VIEW))
    add_member(alice, p1, "nora@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "NoStories", ["view_project"]))

    def story(user, pid, subject, **extra):
        return user.post("userstories", dict(project=pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def get_us(uid):
        return alice.get("userstories/%s" % uid)

    # =====================================================================
    # TAGS
    # =====================================================================
    head("G1  A member adds a tag by name only (no colour)")
    s1 = story(bob, p1, "tagged story", tags=["plain"])
    line("tag stored on the story", ["plain"], get_us(s1["id"])["tags"])
    line("tag appears in the project's tag list", True, "plain" in colors(alice, p1))
    fd = alice.get("userstories/filters_data?project=%s" % p1)
    line("tag offered in the backlog filter (filters_data)", True, any(t["name"] == "plain" for t in fd["tags"]))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "plain", "to_tag": "renamed"}, ok=False)
    line("admin renames that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "plain"}, ok=False)
    line("admin deletes that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   (response)", "", r.text[:90], ok=True)

    head("G2  Who can create project tags and colours")
    r = bob.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "viaadmin", "color": "#ff0000"}, ok=False)
    line("non-admin editor calls the admin 'create tag' endpoint", 403, r.status_code)
    s2 = story(bob, p1, "story 2")
    r = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["bobtag", "#00ff00"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("same editor saves a story with a new [tag, colour] pair", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   project tag list now has his tag+colour", "(admin-only setting)", colors(alice, p1).get("bobtag"), ok=True)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "official", "color": "#111111"})
    s2 = get_us(s2["id"])
    bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["official", "#abcdef"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("editor tries to recolour an existing tag through a story", "#111111", colors(alice, p1).get("official"))
    r = carol.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("comment-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = vic.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("view-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = mallory.call("get", "projects/%s/tags_colors" % p1, ok=False)
    line("outsider reads the project's tag list", "404", r.status_code)

    head("G3  Upper/lower case")
    r1 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "Urgent", "color": "#aa0000"}, ok=False)
    r2 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "URGENT", "color": "#00aa00"}, ok=False)
    line("create 'Urgent' then 'URGENT'", "200 then 400", "%s then %s" % (r1.status_code, r2.status_code))
    raw = alice.get("projects/%s" % p1)["tags_colors"]
    line("   colour stored for 'urgent'", "#aa0000", colors(alice, p1).get("urgent"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "Urgent", "color": "#0000aa"}, ok=False)
    line("edit tag addressed as 'Urgent' (stored as 'urgent')", 200, r.status_code)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "alpha", "color": "#a1a1a1"})
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "beta", "color": "#b2b2b2"})
    sa = story(alice, p1, "has alpha", tags=["alpha"])
    sb = story(alice, p1, "has beta", tags=["beta"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "beta"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'beta'", 400, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "BETA"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'BETA' (capitals)", 400, r.status_code)
    line("   'has alpha' story tags afterwards", ["alpha"], get_us(sa["id"])["tags"])
    line("   colour of 'beta' afterwards", "#b2b2b2", colors(alice, p1).get("beta"))
    line("   'alpha' still in project tag list", True, "alpha" in colors(alice, p1))

    head("G4  Admin tag operations vs editing items one by one")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "old", "color": "#123456"})
    items = {
        "userstories": story(alice, p1, "us with old", tags=["old", "keep"]),
        "tasks": alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "issues": alice.post("issues", {"project": p1, "subject": "issue with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "epics": alice.post("epics", {"project": p1, "subject": "epic with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
    }
    hist_kind = {"userstories": "userstory", "tasks": "task", "issues": "issue", "epics": "epic"}
    before = {k: (v["version"], len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))) for k, v in items.items()}
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "old", "to_tag": "new"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'old' -> 'new' (no colour sent)", 200, r.status_code)
    for k, v in items.items():
        cur = alice.get("%s/%s" % (k, v["id"]))
        hist = len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))
        line("   %s: tags / version bump / new history rows" % k, "has 'new' / (single edit: 1 / 1)",
             "%s / %d / %d" % (cur["tags"], cur["version"] - before[k][0], hist - before[k][1]), ok="new" in cur["tags"])
    line("   colour carried over to 'new'", "#123456", colors(alice, p1).get("new"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "new", "color": "#654321"}, ok=False)
    line("change only the colour of 'new'", "200 #654321", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, colors(alice, p1).get("new")))
    s3 = story(alice, p1, "both", tags=["new", "keep"])
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep2", "color": "#222222"})
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/mix_tags" % p1, {"from_tags": ["new"], "to_tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("merge 'new' into 'keep'", 200, "%s %s" % (r.status_code, r.text[:80]), ok=r.status_code == 200)
    line("   story that had both now has", ["keep"], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("delete 'keep'", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story tags afterwards", [], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])

    head("G5  Filtering by tag")
    story(alice, p1, "f1", tags=["red"])
    story(alice, p1, "f2", tags=["blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f3", tags=["red", "blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f4", tags=["red,blue"])
    n = lambda q: sorted(u["subject"] for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s&%s" % (p1, q)) if u["subject"].startswith("f"))
    line("tags=red", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=red"))
    line("exclude_tags=red", ["f2", "f4"], n("exclude_tags=red"))
    line("tags=red,blue (a tag literally named 'red,blue' exists)", "['f4'] or any-of", n("tags=red,blue"), ok=True)
    line("tags=RED (capitals)", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=RED"))

    head("G6  Blocked / archived project")
    px = new_project(alice, "PX")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1", "color": "#111111"})
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code='archived-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t2", "color": "#222222"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: create tag", 403, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: delete tag", 403, r.status_code)
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code=NULL, blocked_code='blocked-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t3", "color": "#333333"}, ok=False)
    line("blocked project: create tag", 451, r.status_code)

    head("G7  Tags when a story is moved to another project / promoted")
    p3 = new_project(alice, "P3")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "travels", "color": "#777777"})
    sm = story(alice, p1, "moving story", tags=["travels"])
    r = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % sm["id"], {"project": p3, "version": sm["version"], "milestone": None,
                                                 "status": sm["status"], "swimlane": None})
    line("move story to another project", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story keeps the tag", ["travels"], get_us(sm["id"])["tags"])
    line("   tag exists in destination project's tag list", True, "travels" in colors(alice, p3))
    tk = alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task to promote", "tags": ["official"]}).json()
    refs = alice.post("tasks/%s/promote_to_user_story" % tk["id"], {"project_id": p1}).json()
    promoted = [u for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s" % p1) if u["ref"] == refs[0]][0]
    line("task promoted to story keeps its tags", ["official"], promoted["tags"])

    # =====================================================================
    # ATTACHMENTS
    # =====================================================================
    us = story(alice, p1, "story with files")
    uid = us["id"]

    head("H1  Baseline upload by an editor")
    r = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "spec.txt", b"0123456789")
    line("upload", 201, r.status_code)
    a1 = r.json()
    line("   name / size / sha1 present", "spec.txt / 10 / True", "%s / %s / %s" % (a1["name"], a1["size"], bool(a1["sha1"])))
    hist = alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % uid)
    line("   story history records the attachment", True, any("attachments" in (h.get("values_diff") or {}) for h in hist))
    path = os.path.join(MEDIA, a1["attached_file"].split("/media/")[-1].split("?")[0].split("#")[0])
    line("   file is on disk", True, os.path.exists(path))

    head("H2  Limited roles")
    line("view-only member uploads", 403, upload(vic, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
    line("comment-only member uploads a normal attachment", 403, upload(carol, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
    r = upload(carol, "userstories", p1, uid, "pasted.png", b"img", from_comment="true")
    line("comment-only member uploads with from_comment=true", 201, r.status_code)
    ac = r.json()
    r = carol.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % ac["id"], {"from_comment": False})
    line("   then flips it to a normal attachment (from_comment=false)", 403, r.status_code)
    line("   stored from_comment now", True, alice.get("userstories/attachments/%s" % ac["id"])["from_comment"])
    line("comment-only member edits another user's attachment", 403,
         carol.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], {"description": "x"}).status_code)
    line("comment-only member deletes another user's attachment", 403,
         carol.delete("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"]).status_code)
    line("view-only member lists attachments", 2, len(vic.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, uid))))
    line("member without 'view user stories' lists attachments", 0,
         len(nora.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, uid))))
    line("   ... and opens one by id", 404, nora.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    lst = nora.call("get", "userstories?project=%s&include_attachments=1" % p1, ok=False)
    line("   ... and lists stories with include_attachments", "0 stories", "%d stories" % len(lst.json()))

    head("H3  Outsider (not a member of P1)")
    line("lists P1 attachments", 0, len(mallory.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s" % p1)))
    line("opens a P1 attachment by id", 404, mallory.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    line("uploads to a P1 story", 403, upload(mallory, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
    line("uploads naming her own project but a P1 story", 400, upload(mallory, "userstories", p2, uid).status_code)
    line("edits a P1 attachment", 404, mallory.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], {"description": "x"}).status_code)
    line("deletes a P1 attachment", 404, mallory.delete("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"]).status_code)

    head("H4  Re-pointing an existing attachment at another item")
    ms = story(mallory, p2, "mallory's story")
    am = upload(mallory, "userstories", p2, ms["id"], "from-outside.txt", b"planted").json()
    n_before = len(alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, uid)))
    h_before = len(alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % uid))
    r = mallory.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % am["id"], {"project": p1, "object_id": uid})
    line("outsider moves HER attachment onto a P1 story (project+object_id)", "403/400", r.status_code, ok=r.status_code in (400, 403))
    after = alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, uid))
    line("   attachments on the P1 story (before -> after)", "%d -> %d" % (n_before, n_before), "%d -> %d %s" % (
        n_before, len(after), [a["name"] for a in after if a["owner"] == mallory.id]))
    hist = alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % uid)
    line("   new history rows on the P1 story written by the outsider", 0,
         len([h for h in hist[:len(hist) - h_before] if h["user"]["pk"] == mallory.id]) if len(hist) > h_before else 0)
    r = mallory.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % am["id"], ok=False)

    other = story(alice, p1, "another P1 story")

    line("editor moves an attachment to another story in the same project", "200 (allowed)", r.status_code, ok=True)
    bob.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], {"object_id": uid})
    r = bob.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], {"project": p2, "object_id": ms["id"]})
    line("P1 editor moves a P1 attachment onto the outsider's P2 story", "403/400", r.status_code, ok=r.status_code in (400, 403))
    bob_att_home = alice.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % a1["id"], ok=False).status_code
    line("   P1 admin can still see that attachment", 200, bob_att_home)

    head("H5  Replacing the file of an existing attachment")
    a2 = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "small.txt", b"abc").json()
    r = bob.s.patch(R.BASE + "userstories/attachments/%s" % a2["id"], files={"attached_file": ("bigger.bin", b"x" * 5000)})
    cur = alice.get("userstories/attachments/%s" % a2["id"])
    line("replace file (3 bytes -> 5000 bytes)", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   name / size / sha1 changed", "bigger.bin / 5000 / True",
         "%s / %s / %s" % (cur["name"], cur["size"], cur["sha1"] != a2["sha1"]))
    line("full update (PUT)", "405-ish", "%s %s" % (bob.s.put(R.BASE + "userstories/attachments/%s" % a2["id"],
                                                             data={"description": "x"}).status_code, ""), ok=True)

    head("H6  Reordering attachments")
    o = story(alice, p1, "ordering story")
    ids = [upload(alice, "userstories", p1, o["id"], "%s.txt" % n, n.encode(), order=i + 1).json()["id"] for i, n in enumerate("abcd")]
    names = lambda: "".join(a["name"][0] for a in sorted(alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, o["id"])),
                                                         key=lambda a: (a["order"], a["id"])))
    line("start order", "abcd", names())
    r = alice.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order", {"object_id": o["id"], "bulk_attachments": [ids[3]]}, ok=False)
    line("move d to the top", "200 dabc", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, names()))
    r = alice.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order", {"object_id": o["id"], "after_attachment_id": ids[1],
                                                                 "bulk_attachments": [ids[3]]}, ok=False)
    line("move d after b", "200 abdc", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, names()))
    r = alice.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order", {"object_id": 999999999, "bulk_attachments": []}, ok=False)
    line("reorder on a story id that does not exist", "400/404", r.status_code, ok=r.status_code in (400, 404))
    r = vic.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order", {"object_id": o["id"], "bulk_attachments": [ids[0]]}, ok=False)
    line("view-only member reorders", 403, r.status_code)
    r = mallory.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order", {"object_id": o["id"], "bulk_attachments": [ids[0]]}, ok=False)
    line("outsider reorders", "403/404", r.status_code, ok=r.status_code in (403, 404))

    head("H7  Promote a task with attachments to a user story")
    tk = alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task with files"}).json()
    t_att = [upload(alice, "tasks", p1, tk["id"], n, body, order=i + 1, description="d-" + n).json()
             for i, (n, body) in enumerate([("z-first.txt", b"one"), ("a-second.txt", b"two!")])]
    alice.patch("tasks/attachments/%s" % t_att[1]["id"], {"is_deprecated": True}, ok=True)
    refs = alice.post("tasks/%s/promote_to_user_story" % tk["id"], {"project_id": p1}).json()
    new_us = [u for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s" % p1) if u["ref"] == refs[0]][0]
    got = sorted(alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, new_us["id"])), key=lambda a: (a["order"], a["id"]))
    line("story got both files", ["z-first.txt", "a-second.txt"], [a["name"] for a in got])
    line("   same content (sha1), size, description, deprecated flag", True,
         all(g["sha1"] == t["sha1"] and g["size"] == t["size"] and g["description"] == t["description"] for g, t in zip(got, t_att))
         and got[1]["is_deprecated"] is True)
    line("   order values kept", [1, 2], [a["order"] for a in got])
    line("   original task is gone", 404, alice.call("get", "tasks/%s" % tk["id"], ok=False).status_code)

    head("H8  Move a story with an attachment to another project")
    mv = story(alice, p1, "moving with file")
    att = upload(alice, "userstories", p1, mv["id"], "contract.txt", b"secret terms").json()
    r = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % mv["id"], {"project": p3, "version": mv["version"], "milestone": None,
                                                 "status": mv["status"], "swimlane": None})
    line("move story P1 -> P3", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   attachment listed under the new project", 1,
         len(alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p3, mv["id"]))))
    line("   attachment still listed under the OLD project", 0,
         len(alice.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s&object_id=%s" % (p1, mv["id"]))))
    line("   P1 editor (not in P3) can still open it", 404,
         bob.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % att["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    line("   P1 editor can still open the story itself", 404,
         bob.call("get", "userstories/%s" % mv["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    line("   attachment's project field", p3, alice.get("userstories/attachments/%s" % att["id"])["project"])

    head("H9  Deleting")
    d = story(alice, p1, "to delete")
    da = upload(alice, "userstories", p1, d["id"], "gone.txt", b"bye").json()
    dpath = os.path.join(MEDIA, da["attached_file"].split("/media/")[-1].split("?")[0].split("#")[0])
    alice.delete("userstories/%s" % d["id"], ok=True)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    line("delete story: attachment record gone", 404, alice.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % da["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    line("   file removed from disk", True, not os.path.exists(dpath))
    d2 = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "mine.txt", b"mine").json()
    d2path = os.path.join(MEDIA, d2["attached_file"].split("/media/")[-1].split("?")[0].split("#")[0])
    line("uploader deletes own attachment", 204, bob.delete("userstories/attachments/%s" % d2["id"]).status_code)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    line("   file removed from disk", True, not os.path.exists(d2path))

    head("H10 Uploader removed from the project")
    mine = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "bobs.txt", b"bob").json()
    alice.delete("memberships/%s" % bob_m["id"], ok=True)
    line("ex-member opens his old attachment", 404, bob.call("get", "userstories/attachments/%s" % mine["id"], ok=False).status_code)
    line("ex-member lists project attachments", 0, len(bob.get("userstories/attachments?project=%s" % p1)))
    line("ex-member edits his old attachment", 404, bob.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % mine["id"], {"description": "x"}).status_code)
    line("ex-member deletes his old attachment", 404, bob.delete("userstories/attachments/%s" % mine["id"]).status_code)

    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code='archived-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % py)
    line("archived: upload", 403, upload(alice, "userstories", py, ys["id"]).status_code)
    line("archived: edit attachment", 403, alice.patch("userstories/attachments/%s" % ya[0]["id"], {"description": "x"}).status_code)

    line("archived: reorder attachments", 403, alice.post("userstories/attachments/bulk_update_order",

    line("blocked: delete attachment", 451, alice.delete("userstories/attachments/%s" % ya[0]["id"]).status_code)

"""Tags and attachments, driven over the real HTTP API (gunicorn + Postgres).

Users:  alice   = owner/admin of project P1
        bob     = member of P1, full editor role, not admin
        carol   = member of P1, can view and comment only
        vic     = member of P1, view only
        nora    = member of P1, can see the project but not user stories
        mallory = not a member of P1; owns her own project P2
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], "1", "none"]
import race as R  # noqa: E402  (User class, BASE)

MEDIA = "/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad/media"
VIEW = ["view_project", "view_milestones", "view_epics", "view_us", "view_tasks", "view_issues"]


def sql(stmt):
    subprocess.run(["docker", "exec", "taiga-audit-pg", "psql", "-U", "taiga", "-d", "taiga", "-q", "-c", stmt],
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def line(label, expect, got, ok=None):
    if ok is None:
        ok = str(expect) == str(got)
    print("  [%s] %-62s expect: %-22s got: %s" % ("ok " if ok else "DIFF", label, expect, got))
    sys.stdout.flush()


def head(title):
    print("\n" + "=" * 110 + "\n" + title)


def upload(user, kind, pid, oid, name="spec.txt", body=b"hello attachment", **extra):
    data = dict(project=pid, object_id=oid, **extra)
    return user.s.post(R.BASE + "%s/attachments" % kind, data=data, files={"attached_file": (name, body)})


def new_project(owner, name):
    p = owner.post("projects", {"name": "%s %d" % (name, int(time.time() * 1000)), "description": "x",
                                "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
    return p["id"]


def add_member(owner, pid, email, role_id, admin=False):
    return owner.post("memberships", {"project": pid, "role": role_id, "username": email, "is_admin": admin}).json()


def make_role(owner, pid, name, perms):
    return owner.post("roles", {"project": pid, "name": name, "permissions": perms, "computable": False,
                                "order": 99}).json()["id"]


def colors(user, pid):
    return user.get("projects/%s/tags_colors" % pid)


def main():
    alice, bob, carol, vic, nora, mallory = [R.User(n) for n in ("alice", "bob", "carol", "vic", "nora", "mallory")]
    p1 = new_project(alice, "P1")
    p2 = new_project(mallory, "P2")
    roles = {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in alice.get("roles?project=%s" % p1)}
    bob_m = add_member(alice, p1, "bob@example.test", roles["Back"])
    add_member(alice, p1, "carol@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Commenter", VIEW + ["comment_us", "comment_task", "comment_issue"]))
    add_member(alice, p1, "vic@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Viewer", VIEW))
    add_member(alice, p1, "nora@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "NoStories", ["view_project"]))

    def story(user, pid, subject, **extra):
        return user.post("userstories", dict(project=pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def get_us(uid):
        return alice.get("userstories/%s" % uid)

    # =====================================================================
    # TAGS
    # =====================================================================
    head("G1  A member adds a tag by name only (no colour)")
    s1 = story(bob, p1, "tagged story", tags=["plain"])
    line("tag stored on the story", ["plain"], get_us(s1["id"])["tags"])
    line("tag appears in the project's tag list", True, "plain" in colors(alice, p1))
    fd = alice.get("userstories/filters_data?project=%s" % p1)
    line("tag offered in the backlog filter (filters_data)", True, any(t["name"] == "plain" for t in fd["tags"]))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "plain", "to_tag": "renamed"}, ok=False)
    line("admin renames that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "plain"}, ok=False)
    line("admin deletes that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   (response)", "", r.text[:90], ok=True)

    head("G2  Who can create project tags and colours")
    r = bob.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "viaadmin", "color": "#ff0000"}, ok=False)
    line("non-admin editor calls the admin 'create tag' endpoint", 403, r.status_code)
    s2 = story(bob, p1, "story 2")
    r = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["bobtag", "#00ff00"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("same editor saves a story with a new [tag, colour] pair", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   project tag list now has his tag+colour", "(admin-only setting)", colors(alice, p1).get("bobtag"), ok=True)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "official", "color": "#111111"})
    s2 = get_us(s2["id"])
    bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["official", "#abcdef"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("editor tries to recolour an existing tag through a story", "#111111", colors(alice, p1).get("official"))
    r = carol.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("comment-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = vic.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("view-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = mallory.call("get", "projects/%s/tags_colors" % p1, ok=False)
    line("outsider reads the project's tag list", "404", r.status_code)

    head("G3  Upper/lower case")
    r1 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "Urgent", "color": "#aa0000"}, ok=False)
    r2 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "URGENT", "color": "#00aa00"}, ok=False)
    line("create 'Urgent' then 'URGENT'", "200 then 400", "%s then %s" % (r1.status_code, r2.status_code))
    raw = alice.get("projects/%s" % p1)["tags_colors"]
    line("   colour stored for 'urgent'", "#aa0000", colors(alice, p1).get("urgent"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "Urgent", "color": "#0000aa"}, ok=False)
    line("edit tag addressed as 'Urgent' (stored as 'urgent')", 200, r.status_code)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "alpha", "color": "#a1a1a1"})
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "beta", "color": "#b2b2b2"})
    sa = story(alice, p1, "has alpha", tags=["alpha"])
    sb = story(alice, p1, "has beta", tags=["beta"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "beta"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'beta'", 400, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "BETA"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'BETA' (capitals)", 400, r.status_code)
    line("   'has alpha' story tags afterwards", ["alpha"], get_us(sa["id"])["tags"])
    line("   colour of 'beta' afterwards", "#b2b2b2", colors(alice, p1).get("beta"))
    line("   'alpha' still in project tag list", True, "alpha" in colors(alice, p1))

    head("G4  Admin tag operations vs editing items one by one")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "old", "color": "#123456"})
    items = {
        "userstories": story(alice, p1, "us with old", tags=["old", "keep"]),
        "tasks": alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "issues": alice.post("issues", {"project": p1, "subject": "issue with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "epics": alice.post("epics", {"project": p1, "subject": "epic with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
    }
    hist_kind = {"userstories": "userstory", "tasks": "task", "issues": "issue", "epics": "epic"}
    before = {k: (v["version"], len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))) for k, v in items.items()}
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "old", "to_tag": "new"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'old' -> 'new' (no colour sent)", 200, r.status_code)
    for k, v in items.items():
        cur = alice.get("%s/%s" % (k, v["id"]))
        hist = len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))
        line("   %s: tags / version bump / new history rows" % k, "has 'new' / (single edit: 1 / 1)",
             "%s / %d / %d" % (cur["tags"], cur["version"] - before[k][0], hist - before[k][1]), ok="new" in cur["tags"])
    line("   colour carried over to 'new'", "#123456", colors(alice, p1).get("new"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "new", "color": "#654321"}, ok=False)
    line("change only the colour of 'new'", "200 #654321", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, colors(alice, p1).get("new")))
    s3 = story(alice, p1, "both", tags=["new", "keep"])
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep2", "color": "#222222"})
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/mix_tags" % p1, {"from_tags": ["new"], "to_tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("merge 'new' into 'keep'", 200, "%s %s" % (r.status_code, r.text[:80]), ok=r.status_code == 200)
    line("   story that had both now has", ["keep"], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("delete 'keep'", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story tags afterwards", [], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])

    head("G5  Filtering by tag")
    story(alice, p1, "f1", tags=["red"])
    story(alice, p1, "f2", tags=["blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f3", tags=["red", "blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f4", tags=["red,blue"])
    n = lambda q: sorted(u["subject"] for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s&%s" % (p1, q)) if u["subject"].startswith("f"))
    line("tags=red", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=red"))
    line("exclude_tags=red", ["f2", "f4"], n("exclude_tags=red"))
    line("tags=red,blue (a tag literally named 'red,blue' exists)", "['f4'] or any-of", n("tags=red,blue"), ok=True)
    line("tags=RED (capitals)", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=RED"))

    head("G6  Blocked / archived project")
    px = new_project(alice, "PX")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1", "color": "#111111"})
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code='archived-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t2", "color": "#222222"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: create tag", 403, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: delete tag", 403, r.status_code)
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code=NULL, blocked_code='blocked-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t3", "color": "#333333"}, ok=False)
    line("blocked project: create tag", 451, r.status_code)

    head("G7  Tags when a story is moved to another project / promoted")
    p3 = new_project(alice, "P3")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "travels", "color": "#777777"})
    sm = story(alice, p1, "moving story", tags=["travels"])
    r = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % sm["id"], {"project": p3, "version": sm["version"], "milestone": None,
                                                 "status": sm["status"], "swimlane": None})
    line("move story to another project", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story keeps the tag", ["travels"], get_us(sm["id"])["tags"])
    line("   tag exists in destination project's tag list", True, "travels" in colors(alice, p3))
    tk = alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task to promote", "tags": ["official"]}).json()
    refs = alice.post("tasks/%s/promote_to_user_story" % tk["id"], {"project_id": p1}).json()
    promoted = [u for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s" % p1) if u["ref"] == refs[0]][0]
    line("task promoted to story keeps its tags", ["official"], promoted["tags"])

    # =====================================================================
    # ATTACHMENTS
    # =====================================================================
    us = story(alice, p1, "story with files")
    uid = us["id"]

    head("H1  Baseline upload by an editor")
    r = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "spec.txt", b"0123456789")
    line("upload", 201, r.status_code)
    a1 = r.json()
    line("   name / size / sha1 present", "spec.txt / 10 / True", "%s / %s / %s" % (a1["name"], a1["size"], bool(a1["sha1"])))
    hist = alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % uid)
    line("   story history records the attachment", True, any("attachments" in (h.get("values_diff") or {}) for h in hist))
    path = os.path.join(MEDIA, a1["attached_file"].split("/media/")[-1].split("?")[0].split("#")[0])
    line("   file is on disk", True, os.path.exists(path))

    head("H2  Limited roles")
    line("view-only member uploads", 403, upload(vic, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
