"""Tags and attachments, driven over the real HTTP API (gunicorn + Postgres).

Users:  alice   = owner/admin of project P1
        bob     = member of P1, full editor role, not admin
        carol   = member of P1, can view and comment only
        vic     = member of P1, view only
        nora    = member of P1, can see the project but not user stories
        mallory = not a member of P1; owns her own project P2
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], "1", "none"]
import race as R  # noqa: E402  (User class, BASE)

MEDIA = "/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad/media"
VIEW = ["view_project", "view_milestones", "view_epics", "view_us", "view_tasks", "view_issues"]


def sql(stmt):
    subprocess.run(["docker", "exec", "taiga-audit-pg", "psql", "-U", "taiga", "-d", "taiga", "-q", "-c", stmt],
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def line(label, expect, got, ok=None):
    if ok is None:
        ok = str(expect) == str(got)
    print("  [%s] %-62s expect: %-22s got: %s" % ("ok " if ok else "DIFF", label, expect, got))
    sys.stdout.flush()


def head(title):
    print("\n" + "=" * 110 + "\n" + title)


def upload(user, kind, pid, oid, name="spec.txt", body=b"hello attachment", **extra):
    data = dict(project=pid, object_id=oid, **extra)
    return user.s.post(R.BASE + "%s/attachments" % kind, data=data, files={"attached_file": (name, body)})


def new_project(owner, name):
    p = owner.post("projects", {"name": "%s %d" % (name, int(time.time() * 1000)), "description": "x",
                                "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
    return p["id"]


def add_member(owner, pid, email, role_id, admin=False):
    return owner.post("memberships", {"project": pid, "role": role_id, "username": email, "is_admin": admin}).json()


def make_role(owner, pid, name, perms):
    return owner.post("roles", {"project": pid, "name": name, "permissions": perms, "computable": False,
                                "order": 99}).json()["id"]


def colors(user, pid):
    return user.get("projects/%s/tags_colors" % pid)


def main():
    alice, bob, carol, vic, nora, mallory = [R.User(n) for n in ("alice", "bob", "carol", "vic", "nora", "mallory")]
    p1 = new_project(alice, "P1")
    p2 = new_project(mallory, "P2")
    roles = {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in alice.get("roles?project=%s" % p1)}
    bob_m = add_member(alice, p1, "bob@example.test", roles["Back"])
    add_member(alice, p1, "carol@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Commenter", VIEW + ["comment_us", "comment_task", "comment_issue"]))
    add_member(alice, p1, "vic@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Viewer", VIEW))
    add_member(alice, p1, "nora@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "NoStories", ["view_project"]))

    def story(user, pid, subject, **extra):
        return user.post("userstories", dict(project=pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def get_us(uid):
        return alice.get("userstories/%s" % uid)

    # =====================================================================
    # TAGS
    # =====================================================================
    head("G1  A member adds a tag by name only (no colour)")
    s1 = story(bob, p1, "tagged story", tags=["plain"])
    line("tag stored on the story", ["plain"], get_us(s1["id"])["tags"])
    line("tag appears in the project's tag list", True, "plain" in colors(alice, p1))
    fd = alice.get("userstories/filters_data?project=%s" % p1)
    line("tag offered in the backlog filter (filters_data)", True, any(t["name"] == "plain" for t in fd["tags"]))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "plain", "to_tag": "renamed"}, ok=False)
    line("admin renames that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "plain"}, ok=False)
    line("admin deletes that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   (response)", "", r.text[:90], ok=True)

    head("G2  Who can create project tags and colours")
    r = bob.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "viaadmin", "color": "#ff0000"}, ok=False)
    line("non-admin editor calls the admin 'create tag' endpoint", 403, r.status_code)
    s2 = story(bob, p1, "story 2")
    r = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["bobtag", "#00ff00"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("same editor saves a story with a new [tag, colour] pair", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   project tag list now has his tag+colour", "(admin-only setting)", colors(alice, p1).get("bobtag"), ok=True)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "official", "color": "#111111"})
    s2 = get_us(s2["id"])
    bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["official", "#abcdef"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("editor tries to recolour an existing tag through a story", "#111111", colors(alice, p1).get("official"))
    r = carol.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("comment-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = vic.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("view-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = mallory.call("get", "projects/%s/tags_colors" % p1, ok=False)
    line("outsider reads the project's tag list", "404", r.status_code)

    head("G3  Upper/lower case")
    r1 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "Urgent", "color": "#aa0000"}, ok=False)
    r2 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "URGENT", "color": "#00aa00"}, ok=False)
    line("create 'Urgent' then 'URGENT'", "200 then 400", "%s then %s" % (r1.status_code, r2.status_code))
    raw = alice.get("projects/%s" % p1)["tags_colors"]
    line("   colour stored for 'urgent'", "#aa0000", colors(alice, p1).get("urgent"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "Urgent", "color": "#0000aa"}, ok=False)
    line("edit tag addressed as 'Urgent' (stored as 'urgent')", 200, r.status_code)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "alpha", "color": "#a1a1a1"})
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "beta", "color": "#b2b2b2"})
    sa = story(alice, p1, "has alpha", tags=["alpha"])
    sb = story(alice, p1, "has beta", tags=["beta"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "beta"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'beta'", 400, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "BETA"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'BETA' (capitals)", 400, r.status_code)
    line("   'has alpha' story tags afterwards", ["alpha"], get_us(sa["id"])["tags"])
    line("   colour of 'beta' afterwards", "#b2b2b2", colors(alice, p1).get("beta"))
    line("   'alpha' still in project tag list", True, "alpha" in colors(alice, p1))

    head("G4  Admin tag operations vs editing items one by one")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "old", "color": "#123456"})
    items = {
        "userstories": story(alice, p1, "us with old", tags=["old", "keep"]),
        "tasks": alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "issues": alice.post("issues", {"project": p1, "subject": "issue with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "epics": alice.post("epics", {"project": p1, "subject": "epic with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
    }
    hist_kind = {"userstories": "userstory", "tasks": "task", "issues": "issue", "epics": "epic"}
    before = {k: (v["version"], len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))) for k, v in items.items()}
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "old", "to_tag": "new"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'old' -> 'new' (no colour sent)", 200, r.status_code)
    for k, v in items.items():
        cur = alice.get("%s/%s" % (k, v["id"]))
        hist = len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))
        line("   %s: tags / version bump / new history rows" % k, "has 'new' / (single edit: 1 / 1)",
             "%s / %d / %d" % (cur["tags"], cur["version"] - before[k][0], hist - before[k][1]), ok="new" in cur["tags"])
    line("   colour carried over to 'new'", "#123456", colors(alice, p1).get("new"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "new", "color": "#654321"}, ok=False)
    line("change only the colour of 'new'", "200 #654321", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, colors(alice, p1).get("new")))
    s3 = story(alice, p1, "both", tags=["new", "keep"])
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep2", "color": "#222222"})
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/mix_tags" % p1, {"from_tags": ["new"], "to_tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("merge 'new' into 'keep'", 200, "%s %s" % (r.status_code, r.text[:80]), ok=r.status_code == 200)
    line("   story that had both now has", ["keep"], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("delete 'keep'", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story tags afterwards", [], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])

    head("G5  Filtering by tag")
    story(alice, p1, "f1", tags=["red"])
    story(alice, p1, "f2", tags=["blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f3", tags=["red", "blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f4", tags=["red,blue"])
    n = lambda q: sorted(u["subject"] for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s&%s" % (p1, q)) if u["subject"].startswith("f"))
    line("tags=red", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=red"))
    line("exclude_tags=red", ["f2", "f4"], n("exclude_tags=red"))
    line("tags=red,blue (a tag literally named 'red,blue' exists)", "['f4'] or any-of", n("tags=red,blue"), ok=True)

"""Tags and attachments, driven over the real HTTP API (gunicorn + Postgres).

Users:  alice   = owner/admin of project P1
        bob     = member of P1, full editor role, not admin
        carol   = member of P1, can view and comment only
        vic     = member of P1, view only
        nora    = member of P1, can see the project but not user stories
        mallory = not a member of P1; owns her own project P2
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], "1", "none"]
import race as R  # noqa: E402  (User class, BASE)

MEDIA = "/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad/media"
VIEW = ["view_project", "view_milestones", "view_epics", "view_us", "view_tasks", "view_issues"]


def sql(stmt):
    subprocess.run(["docker", "exec", "taiga-audit-pg", "psql", "-U", "taiga", "-d", "taiga", "-q", "-c", stmt],
                   check=True, capture_output=True)


def line(label, expect, got, ok=None):
    if ok is None:
        ok = str(expect) == str(got)
    print("  [%s] %-62s expect: %-22s got: %s" % ("ok " if ok else "DIFF", label, expect, got))
    sys.stdout.flush()


def head(title):
    print("\n" + "=" * 110 + "\n" + title)


def upload(user, kind, pid, oid, name="spec.txt", body=b"hello attachment", **extra):
    data = dict(project=pid, object_id=oid, **extra)
    return user.s.post(R.BASE + "%s/attachments" % kind, data=data, files={"attached_file": (name, body)})


def new_project(owner, name):
    p = owner.post("projects", {"name": "%s %d" % (name, int(time.time() * 1000)), "description": "x",
                                "creation_template": 1, "is_private": True}).json()
    return p["id"]


def add_member(owner, pid, email, role_id, admin=False):
    return owner.post("memberships", {"project": pid, "role": role_id, "username": email, "is_admin": admin}).json()


def make_role(owner, pid, name, perms):
    return owner.post("roles", {"project": pid, "name": name, "permissions": perms, "computable": False,
                                "order": 99}).json()["id"]


def colors(user, pid):
    return user.get("projects/%s/tags_colors" % pid)


def main():
    alice, bob, carol, vic, nora, mallory = [R.User(n) for n in ("alice", "bob", "carol", "vic", "nora", "mallory")]
    p1 = new_project(alice, "P1")
    p2 = new_project(mallory, "P2")
    roles = {r["name"]: r["id"] for r in alice.get("roles?project=%s" % p1)}
    bob_m = add_member(alice, p1, "bob@example.test", roles["Back"])
    add_member(alice, p1, "carol@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Commenter", VIEW + ["comment_us", "comment_task", "comment_issue"]))
    add_member(alice, p1, "vic@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "Viewer", VIEW))
    add_member(alice, p1, "nora@example.test", make_role(alice, p1, "NoStories", ["view_project"]))

    def story(user, pid, subject, **extra):
        return user.post("userstories", dict(project=pid, subject=subject, **extra)).json()

    def get_us(uid):
        return alice.get("userstories/%s" % uid)

    # =====================================================================
    # TAGS
    # =====================================================================
    head("G1  A member adds a tag by name only (no colour)")
    s1 = story(bob, p1, "tagged story", tags=["plain"])
    line("tag stored on the story", ["plain"], get_us(s1["id"])["tags"])
    line("tag appears in the project's tag list", True, "plain" in colors(alice, p1))
    fd = alice.get("userstories/filters_data?project=%s" % p1)
    line("tag offered in the backlog filter (filters_data)", True, any(t["name"] == "plain" for t in fd["tags"]))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "plain", "to_tag": "renamed"}, ok=False)
    line("admin renames that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "plain"}, ok=False)
    line("admin deletes that tag", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   (response)", "", r.text[:90], ok=True)

    head("G2  Who can create project tags and colours")
    r = bob.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "viaadmin", "color": "#ff0000"}, ok=False)
    line("non-admin editor calls the admin 'create tag' endpoint", 403, r.status_code)
    s2 = story(bob, p1, "story 2")
    r = bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["bobtag", "#00ff00"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("same editor saves a story with a new [tag, colour] pair", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   project tag list now has his tag+colour", "(admin-only setting)", colors(alice, p1).get("bobtag"), ok=True)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "official", "color": "#111111"})
    s2 = get_us(s2["id"])
    bob.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": [["official", "#abcdef"]], "version": s2["version"]})
    line("editor tries to recolour an existing tag through a story", "#111111", colors(alice, p1).get("official"))
    r = carol.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("comment-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = vic.patch("userstories/%s" % s2["id"], {"tags": ["x"], "version": get_us(s2["id"])["version"]})
    line("view-only member changes tags", 403, r.status_code)
    r = mallory.call("get", "projects/%s/tags_colors" % p1, ok=False)
    line("outsider reads the project's tag list", "404", r.status_code)

    head("G3  Upper/lower case")
    r1 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "Urgent", "color": "#aa0000"}, ok=False)
    r2 = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "URGENT", "color": "#00aa00"}, ok=False)
    line("create 'Urgent' then 'URGENT'", "200 then 400", "%s then %s" % (r1.status_code, r2.status_code))
    raw = alice.get("projects/%s" % p1)["tags_colors"]
    line("   colour stored for 'urgent'", "#aa0000", colors(alice, p1).get("urgent"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "Urgent", "color": "#0000aa"}, ok=False)
    line("edit tag addressed as 'Urgent' (stored as 'urgent')", 200, r.status_code)
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "alpha", "color": "#a1a1a1"})
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "beta", "color": "#b2b2b2"})
    sa = story(alice, p1, "has alpha", tags=["alpha"])
    sb = story(alice, p1, "has beta", tags=["beta"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "beta"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'beta'", 400, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "alpha", "to_tag": "BETA"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'alpha' to existing 'BETA' (capitals)", 400, r.status_code)
    line("   'has alpha' story tags afterwards", ["alpha"], get_us(sa["id"])["tags"])
    line("   colour of 'beta' afterwards", "#b2b2b2", colors(alice, p1).get("beta"))
    line("   'alpha' still in project tag list", True, "alpha" in colors(alice, p1))

    head("G4  Admin tag operations vs editing items one by one")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "old", "color": "#123456"})
    items = {
        "userstories": story(alice, p1, "us with old", tags=["old", "keep"]),
        "tasks": alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "issues": alice.post("issues", {"project": p1, "subject": "issue with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
        "epics": alice.post("epics", {"project": p1, "subject": "epic with old", "tags": ["old"]}).json(),
    }
    hist_kind = {"userstories": "userstory", "tasks": "task", "issues": "issue", "epics": "epic"}
    before = {k: (v["version"], len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))) for k, v in items.items()}
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "old", "to_tag": "new"}, ok=False)
    line("rename 'old' -> 'new' (no colour sent)", 200, r.status_code)
    for k, v in items.items():
        cur = alice.get("%s/%s" % (k, v["id"]))
        hist = len(alice.get("history/%s/%s" % (hist_kind[k], v["id"])))
        line("   %s: tags / version bump / new history rows" % k, "has 'new' / (single edit: 1 / 1)",
             "%s / %d / %d" % (cur["tags"], cur["version"] - before[k][0], hist - before[k][1]), ok="new" in cur["tags"])
    line("   colour carried over to 'new'", "#123456", colors(alice, p1).get("new"))
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/edit_tag" % p1, {"from_tag": "new", "color": "#654321"}, ok=False)
    line("change only the colour of 'new'", "200 #654321", "%s %s" % (r.status_code, colors(alice, p1).get("new")))
    s3 = story(alice, p1, "both", tags=["new", "keep"])
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep2", "color": "#222222"})
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/mix_tags" % p1, {"from_tags": ["new"], "to_tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("merge 'new' into 'keep'", 200, "%s %s" % (r.status_code, r.text[:80]), ok=r.status_code == 200)
    line("   story that had both now has", ["keep"], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % p1, {"tag": "keep"}, ok=False)
    line("delete 'keep'", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story tags afterwards", [], get_us(s3["id"])["tags"])

    head("G5  Filtering by tag")
    story(alice, p1, "f1", tags=["red"])
    story(alice, p1, "f2", tags=["blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f3", tags=["red", "blue"])
    story(alice, p1, "f4", tags=["red,blue"])
    n = lambda q: sorted(u["subject"] for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s&%s" % (p1, q)) if u["subject"].startswith("f"))
    line("tags=red", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=red"))
    line("exclude_tags=red", ["f2", "f4"], n("exclude_tags=red"))
    line("tags=red,blue (a tag literally named 'red,blue' exists)", "['f4'] or any-of", n("tags=red,blue"), ok=True)
    line("tags=RED (capitals)", ["f1", "f3"], n("tags=RED"))

    head("G6  Blocked / archived project")
    px = new_project(alice, "PX")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1", "color": "#111111"})
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code='archived-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t2", "color": "#222222"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: create tag", 403, r.status_code)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/delete_tag" % px, {"tag": "t1"}, ok=False)
    line("archived project: delete tag", 403, r.status_code)
    sql("UPDATE projects_project SET archived_code=NULL, blocked_code='blocked-by-staff' WHERE id=%d" % px)
    r = alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % px, {"tag": "t3", "color": "#333333"}, ok=False)
    line("blocked project: create tag", 451, r.status_code)

    head("G7  Tags when a story is moved to another project / promoted")
    p3 = new_project(alice, "P3")
    alice.post("projects/%s/create_tag" % p1, {"tag": "travels", "color": "#777777"})
    sm = story(alice, p1, "moving story", tags=["travels"])
    r = alice.patch("userstories/%s" % sm["id"], {"project": p3, "version": sm["version"], "milestone": None,
                                                 "status": sm["status"], "swimlane": None})
    line("move story to another project", 200, r.status_code)
    line("   story keeps the tag", ["travels"], get_us(sm["id"])["tags"])
    line("   tag exists in destination project's tag list", True, "travels" in colors(alice, p3))
    tk = alice.post("tasks", {"project": p1, "subject": "task to promote", "tags": ["official"]}).json()
    refs = alice.post("tasks/%s/promote_to_user_story" % tk["id"], {"project_id": p1}).json()
    promoted = [u for u in alice.get("userstories?project=%s" % p1) if u["ref"] == refs[0]][0]
    line("task promoted to story keeps its tags", ["official"], promoted["tags"])

    # =====================================================================
    # ATTACHMENTS
    # =====================================================================
    us = story(alice, p1, "story with files")
    uid = us["id"]

    head("H1  Baseline upload by an editor")
    r = upload(bob, "userstories", p1, uid, "spec.txt", b"0123456789")
    line("upload", 201, r.status_code)
    a1 = r.json()
    line("   name / size / sha1 present", "spec.txt / 10 / True", "%s / %s / %s" % (a1["name"], a1["size"], bool(a1["sha1"])))
    hist = alice.get("history/userstory/%s" % uid)
    line("   story history records the attachment", True, any("attachments" in (h.get("values_diff") or {}) for h in hist))
    path = os.path.join(MEDIA, a1["attached_file"].split("/media/")[-1].split("?")[0].split("#")[0])
    line("   file is on disk", True, os.path.exists(path))

    head("H2  Limited roles")
    line("view-only member uploads", 403, upload(vic, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
    line("comment-only member uploads a normal attachment", 403, upload(carol, "userstories", p1, uid).status_code)
    r = upload(carol, "userstories", p1, uid, "pasted.png", b"img", from_comment="true")

lastPrompt: Nothing in your list about tags/attachments. Did you test these? If not go through them now.

content.text:
I've now read and run both areas, and both have real problems. The most serious is that someone outside a project can plant a file on another team's item.

Everything below was run over the HTTP API against gunicorn (3 workers) and Postgres, with six users: owner, editor, comment-only, view-only, a member who can't see user stories, and an outsider with her own project. Races were 20 trials each. Downloading the file itself by URL is handled by the web server, not this repo, so that was not tested.

## Attachments

**Crossing project boundaries**

- **An outsider can plant a file on another project's item.** She uploaded a file to her own story, then edited it with `project` and `object_id` set to the other team's story. It returned 200, the file appeared on that story, and a history entry was written there under her name. The same worked for tasks, issues and epics. She could not read the story, comment on it, or edit the file afterwards. The update only checks permission on the attachment's current project (`taiga/projects/attachments/api.py:52`).
- **An editor can push a project's attachment out to any other project** the same way; the project admin then got 403 on it.
- **Moving a story to another project leaves its attachments behind.** The file was no longer listed under the new project and still listed under the old one. An editor of the old project, not a member of the new one, could still open it.
- **A removed member can still open attachments they uploaded** (200 on the record, which includes the file URL). Listing, editing and deleting were refused.

**Limited roles**

- **A comment-only member can add regular attachments in two steps.** A normal upload was refused (403). Uploading with `from_comment=true` returned 201, and then editing it to `from_comment=false` returned 200.
- View-only upload, editing or deleting other people's files, reordering, and all outsider access to the list were correctly refused. A member without "view user stories" saw no attachments.

**Behaviour**

- **Replacing an attachment's file keeps the old name and size.** A 3-byte `small.txt` replaced by a 5000-byte file still reported `small.txt`, 3 bytes.
- **Promoting a task to a story loses a custom attachment order.** Files arranged c, a, b came out a, b, c. Content, size, description and the deprecated flag were kept.
- **An archived project still accepts attachment reordering** (200). Upload, edit and delete were refused; a blocked project refused everything.
- Upload metadata, history, reordering, and removing files from disk on delete all worked.

**Two users at once**

| Scenario | Result (20 trials) |
|---|---|
| One edits a file's description, the other marks it deprecated | **One change lost in 20/20**, both got 200 |
| One uploads to a story, the other edits that story | **One of them got a 500 in 18/20**; in 8 the upload returned 500 but the file was saved |
| One deletes a file, the other edits it | File deleted; **editor got a 500 in 19/20** |
| Each moves a different file to the top | **One move lost in 11/20**, both got 200 |
| Both upload to the same story | Correct, 20/20 |
| One uploads while the other deletes the story | No leftover record, 20/20; one 500 |

## Tags

**Behaviour**

- **Capitals bypass the "already exists" check.** Creating `Urgent` then `URGENT` both returned 200, and the database held two `urgent` entries with different colours. Renaming `alpha` to `beta` was refused, but renaming it to `BETA` returned 200, merged the two, and overwrote beta's colour.
- **Admin rename, merge and delete change items without a trace.** Stories, tasks, issues and epics got the new tag, but with no history entry and no version bump; a normal edit produces one of each.
- **An archived project still accepts tag create and delete** (200). A blocked project refused.
- **A non-admin editor can add tags and colours to the project's tag list** by saving a story with a new tag, even though the settings endpoint returns 403 for them. They could not recolour an existing tag.
- **The tag filter is case-sensitive and splits on commas.** `tags=RED` returned nothing for stories tagged `red`; a tag named `red,blue` cannot be filtered on its own.
- Comment-only and view-only members could not change tags, and the outsider could not read the tag list. Tags survived moving a story to another project and promoting a task. Renaming without a colour kept the colour.

**Two users at once**

| Scenario | Result (20 trials) |
|---|---|
| Each tags a different story with a new coloured tag | **One tag missing from the project tag list in 20/20** (still on its story) |
| Admin creates a tag in settings while an editor tags a story | **Admin's tag missing in 19/20**, both got 200 |
| Admin deletes a tag while an editor edits a story carrying it | **Story kept the deleted tag in 16/20**; in 14 the tag was back in the project list |
| Both set different tags on the same story | 19/20 correct (one 200, one 400); **1/20 both got 200 and one was lost** |

The repo is untouched; the test server and database container are stopped and removed.

Files are in `/tmp/claude-0/-exp-PREWORK-fgilywv4-model-a/09c7f0f3-ccaf-43bb-94b2-080642dbd748/scratchpad`:
- `probe/tags_attachments.py`
- `probe/tags_attachments_2.py`
- `ta1.txt`
- `ta2.txt`

message.content: Just to recap everything from this session, give me a final list of all the issues. Indicate what you ran, what you read and what wasn't tested. Rank them in order of how bad they are to roll out to clients.

content.text:
Below is every issue from this session, ranked by how bad it would be to roll out to clients, with a status on each. "Read" items come from the code only and are unconfirmed; I ranked them by their impact if they hold.

- **Ran**: reproduced over the HTTP API against Postgres (two-user cases on gunicorn with 3 workers, 20 trials each).
- **Read**: found by reading the code, never executed.

## Stop before rollout

| # | Issue | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A story can reference any project's issue or task; the response returns that item's title and a comment is posted on it | Read |
| 2 | Any story can be linked to your own epic; its title, ref and project name then show in your project timeline | Read |
| 3 | An outsider can plant a file on another project's story, task, issue or epic by re-pointing her own attachment | Ran |
| 4 | Two users saving the same item within about 0.3 s: one change is silently lost (story, task, issue, epic, sprint, attachment); a status change is lost when someone comments at the same moment | Ran |
| 5 | A view-only member can promote a task to a story, which deletes the task | Read (promotion itself ran as admin) |
| 6 | Stories can be attached to any project's epic (permission checked on a different epic than the one saved; bulk create never checks the epic) | Read |
| 7 | Stories can be moved into another project's sprint via `move_userstories_to_sprint` | Read |

## Fix soon

| # | Issue | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Two simultaneous drags: one move lost (backlog 12/20, attachment order 11/20) | Ran |
| 9 | Sprint open/closed flag wrong after `bulk_update_milestone` (stories, tasks, issues) and `issues/bulk_create`; corrects itself on the next single save | Ran |
| 10 | Stories bulk-created in Done are not counted as closed | Ran |
| 11 | Simultaneous tagging: a new tag vanishes from the project list (20/20), an admin-created tag vanishes (19/20), a deleted tag stays on the story (16/20) | Ran |
| 12 | Nested data ignores per-type view permissions (sprints return stories without "view user stories", `include_tasks`, project stats) | Read |
| 13 | Overlapping actions return server errors: drag vs edit 15/20, upload vs edit 18/20 (8 with the file saved anyway), delete vs edit 19/20 | Ran |
| 14 | A task ends up in a different sprint from its story (both bulk task moves; 2/20 when a task is added during a sprint move) | Ran |
| 15 | Two users dragging one story to different columns: 5/20 ended In progress but flagged closed | Ran |
| 16 | Blocked and archived projects still accept bulk moves and creates, tag create/delete, and attachment reorder | Ran |
| 17 | A project admin can make themselves owner by writing a transfer token | Read |
| 18 | A project admin can un-archive a staff-archived project and set featured/counters | Read |
| 19 | A comment-only member can add regular attachments in two steps | Ran |
| 20 | `modify_epic` is enough to create stories; issue promotion checks `add_us` in the wrong project | Read |
| 21 | Anyone, including anonymous, can list which story ids are linked to any epic | Read |
| 22 | Private project backlog and sprint counts leak through response headers | Read |
| 23 | Moving a story to another project leaves its attachments in the old one, still openable by old-project members | Ran |
| 24 | A removed member can still open attachments they uploaded | Ran |
| 25 | Deleting a role without `moveTo` deletes every member who has it, including the owner | Read |
| 26 | Editing a membership can hand it to a different account that now owns the invitation email | Read |
| 27 | A project admin can push statuses, roles and other settings objects into another project | Read |
| 28 | An editor can push a project's attachment out to another project | Ran |
| 29 | Bulk-created issues accept a sprint id from any project | Read |

## Lower priority

| # | Issue | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | Bulk moves notify nobody and never bump the version | Ran |
| 31 | Tag names in different capitals create duplicates; renaming to an existing tag in capitals silently merges and overwrites its colour | Ran |
| 32 | Admin tag rename, merge and delete change items with no history entry | Ran |
| 33 | `tasks/bulk_create` refuses a story still in the backlog; bulk-created closed tasks get no finished date | Ran |
| 34 | Replacing an attachment's file keeps the old name and size; promoting a task loses a custom attachment order | Ran |
| 35 | `issues/bulk_update_milestone` writes no history | Ran |
| 36 | A non-admin editor can add tags to the project list; tag filter is case-sensitive and splits on commas | Ran |
| 37 | Moving a story to another project leaves its tasks behind | Read |
| 38 | Project duplication counts the wrong limit | Read |
| 39 | All assignees are re-notified on each change; `assigned_users` is not checked against membership | Read |
| 40 | Bulk-inviting an existing member hits a database error; `create_template` and due-date `create_default` crash; sprint stats loop is uncapped; issue bulk-move events use the wrong type | Read |

## Withdrawn

- Task reordering ignoring the user story (from my first list): the run showed no visible effect.

## Ran and found correct

- Bulk story and task creation in the normal case, `bulk_update_backlog_order` moves and six reorder cases, and the three `milestones/<id>/move_*_to_sprint` calls.
- A stale browser copy: a different field is merged, the same field is refused.
- Simultaneous comments, creates, closing the last two tasks or stories, and uploads to one story.
- Attachment and tag permissions for view-only, comment-only and outsider users, apart from the rows above.

## Not tested

- Downloading an attachment file by its URL; that is served by the web server, not this repo.
- Which frontend button calls which endpoint; the frontend is not in this repo.
- Email delivery, webhooks and live board events; email was disabled and Celery was off in every run.
- Wiki, importers and exporters, comment editing, custom attribute values, votes and watchers.
- More than two simultaneous users, and upload size limits.

I can run the Read rows next; rows 1–7 are the ones I'd confirm before any client gets access. I can also turn this into a shareable page.
